svg.title: The agent metadata stack
svg.desc: Five layers resting on a correct model. From the bottom: a correct model, then field and object descriptions, then synonyms and business vocabulary, then governed metrics as the agent's vocabulary of answers, then business preferences and defaults.
svg.text: What the agent reads, and what it rests on
Metadata only helps once the model underneath is correct
Default currency and date field, fiscal or calendar year, which definition is the house default
3. Governed metrics — the agent's vocabulary of answers
Ask for win rate and get the governed one, not a fresh SUM/SUM it improvised
reps, AEs, sellers → User · bookings → closed-won Order.Amount
“ACV: annualized contract value, excludes one-time fees” — the highest-leverage metadata
Shape, cardinality, grain, calc placement, context. Non-optional.
Rich descriptions on a broken model just help the agent find the wrong answer faster.
